mission.title: To the Dogs
mission.description: Make an example of the lupines agitating against the Merovingian.

npc.say: Betraying the Merovingian is a good way to end up dead in a hurry.

phase.briefing:
It seems, human, that some of our wolfish friends have been getting out of hand. As you know, the Merovingian is not in the habit of tolerating dissent in his ranks.
I want you to make an example of these disruptive lupines. A messy one. You seem to be good at making messes, so this shouldn't be a problem for you, eh?

enter.say: I'm scanning a bunch of lupines in there. You only need to take out any that are agitating.

phase.briefing: That wasn't too bad, for you; but you're not done yet. It seems that our lupine malcontents have scattered around the area. Ironic that they, who are usually the hunters, are now the hunted, no?

enter.say: I'm picking up more lupines in there. Let's see if any of them are misbehaving.

phase.briefing: A few more killings should get the message across. Are you warming to your task? You should be.

enter.say: More lupines in there, all right.

objective.text: Kill the last of the lupine malcontents

near.say: Mercy? I don't think the Merovingian knows the meaning of the word. You'd better take them out.

mission.finish:
Hmm. I suppose that was passable. It took you an awfully long time to finish off those puppies.
I think you may need more canine training. We'll have to see what we can do about this.
